models.label: QMix Cut-512
models.description: A compact, browser-oriented background segmentation model: an optimised BiRefNet Lite variant with a weight-only int8 backbone (m.bb.*, m.squeeze_module.*) + fp16 decoder, materialised to fp32, with PyTorch debug metadata and duplicate initializers stripped (lossless, bit-identical outputs). On the repo test images it reproduces the fp32 teacher exactly; on the wider 62-image set it averages IoU@0.5 0.981 with one empty-mask miss.
